QuestInfo.name: Collecting 50 Cursed Dolls
QuestInfo.parent: Rowen the Fairy and the Cursed Doll
QuestInfo.0: I think #p305# in #m10002000# has something to ask me...
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #b#p305##k again, who had given me #t4031031# for #p320#, #p608#'s son, last time. Back then, she seemed guarded, but now, she's accepted me as #p320#'s friend... \r\n\r\n#p305# is an assistant for the head magician of Ellinia, #p313#. She's concerned about the #t4000033#s: evil dolls he'd made with black magic, a long, long time ago. While they'd been sealed for quite some time, a bunch of #o35#s recently stole them and got away. The #o35#s have since become zombies and are destroying the forest. To take back the forest, someone needs to eliminate the #r#o38#s#k and take the #b#t4000033#s#k away from them... So, I readily accepted the request to collect #b50 Cursed Dolls#k, but I fear those crazy monkeys may be too much to handle...
QuestInfo.2: I eliminated a bunch of #o38#s in a forest near #m10002000# and collected all #b50 #t4000033#s#k for Rowen. In return, she gave me 7 ores. I hope the forest returns to normal...

0.0: You're #p320#'s friend. You came at just the right time. It's not easy for me to ask a human for help, but... I have a hunch that I can trust you on this.
0.1: Allow me to introduce myself. I'm #p305#, secretary of the Head Magician in this town, #b#p313##k. We've been looking for a traveler who can help us out. Well, would you like to hear the whole story?
0.2: #p313# used to be very much into #bblack magic#k, which was considered off limits. Black magic is VERY powerful, but there's a chance it can backfire and the Magician casting the spell might lose the ability to use magic altogether. So it's very potent but requires utmost caution.
0.3: #p313# wasn't fully trained, but he thought he could handle it. He tried to bring a straw doll to life. Anyone with half a brain knows that magic that has to do with life itself is absolutely forbidden!
0.4: Something went terribly wrong in the process, and the curse of black magic seeped into the doll, transforming it into a #r#t4000033##k that had to be sealed up forever. In the end, #p313# was able to seal the #t4000033# up and hid it away somewhere.
0.5: But then, the #o35#s that live around #m10002000# Forest took the doll. When they returned to the forest, they became zombies. The #r#o38#s#k are now wreaking havoc in the forest. #p313# assigned me to handle the situation, but he could hardly expect me to resolve the whole thing on my own.
0.6: To get the forest back to the way it used to be, we need to kill the #r#o38#s#k and remove the #b#t4000033#s#k. I'm awfully busy here, so will you do it in my place?

yes.0: Thank you so much. The #o38#s have been frequently sighted in the Monkey Forest near #m10002000#. Please hunt #r50 #o38#s#k and bring me #b50#k #b#t4000033#s#k. You will be well rewarded.

no.0: I see... I thought you were the right person to ask, but I guess I was wrong... I understand that you're busy, but if you ever have a change of heart, please find me.

1.0: This is... Wow! You've brought me #b50 #t4000033#s#k! That means you've thinned out the #o38#s. But it's too early to be relieved, because this doll is capable of continuously making new puppets.
1.1: Oh yeah, take this as a token of my appreciation. The fairies will spread word of your good deed. I personally think you deserve to be called a hero, and not just because you saved me from a pickle!

yes.0: I have increased your fame a little. I've also gotten you some ores from the forest. Please put them to good use. So long!

mob.0: Don't forget to defeat the #r#o38#s#k as well.

item.0: So, you weren't able to collect #b50 #t4000033#s#k yet. The #t4000033# is making more Puppets of itself as we speak. You need to hurry up and bring me the dolls.
